analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 sessions held a wait-and-see stance. RSI dipped slightly to 54.9 but remains far from oversold territory (<30). MACD histogram improved to -2.4346 but stays negative, making a trend reversal uncertain. Volume ratio at 0.87 indicates subdued activity. At 72.8% of its 52-week high, upside potential exists, but breaking the 500.76 swing resistance is key.

[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.87배): 움직임의 신뢰도 보통 수준
· 현 구간 진단 (상승추세): 500.76 저항선 돌파 시 매수 진입 고려
